name: Content Entity Builder
project_description: Content Entity Builder lets you build a custom content entity type and add base fields to it entirely through the admin UI, storing the definition as a config entity and applying it to the database on save. Four modes control the shape of the entity type: Basic (one entity, one table, no bundles), Basic Plus (adds bundles), Advanced (adds bundles, translatability, owner, changed and published), and Full (adds revisions, like a node). At runtime the entity types are registered dynamically in memory via hook_entity_type_build; nothing is written to your codebase. Base fields are provided by a pluggable BaseFieldConfig plugin type covering string, text (plain/long/formatted), integer, decimal, float, boolean, email, telephone, datetime, timestamp, created, changed, entity reference and list fields. An optional Export feature scaffolds a real Drupal module (entity classes, forms, access handlers, routing, permissions) from your content types and hands it to you as a downloadable .tar.gz, so you can graduate a prototyped entity type to hand-maintained code. Similar to ECK.
